description: This file contains SDK/HTTP implementations for native PDF document input providers, specifically for Anthropic and Google Gemini APIs, including functions to analyze PDFs via these services.

methods.name: anthropicAnalyzePdf
methods.description: Analyzes PDF documents using Anthropic's Messages API, sending base64-encoded PDFs and returning extracted text.

methods.name: geminiAnalyzePdf
methods.description: Analyzes PDF documents using Google Gemini's generateContent API, sending base64-encoded PDFs and returning extracted text.
